settingsDescription: Reward people for coming back. Points are money you already owe, so set the rate deliberately.
enabledHelp: Off means nothing is earned and nothing can be spent. Existing balances are kept.
pointsPerUnitHelp: Points are only ever awarded on what was actually paid.
pointValueHelp: In taka, when the point is spent against a sale.
fieldMinRedeem: Fewest points that can be spent at once
expiryMonthsHelp: In months. Leave empty if points never expire.
previewLine: Spend {spend} and earn {points} points, worth {worth} off a future visit.
previewOff: Nothing is being earned or spent while the programme is off.
previewExpiry: Points expire {months} months after they are earned.
